title: FileGrid Overview
description: p50/p95/p99, throughput and errors per category × storage; meter exactly-once; storage health. Metric names: contracts/metrics.md.

panels.title: Services running
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status of every service (`up`, 1 = scraped).

panels.title: Handled per second
panels.description: filegrid_ops_total: all storage operations per second for the selected category, storage and op.

panels.title: Operations failing
panels.description: filegrid_ops_total: share with outcome=error. Fallback writes are not errors.

targets.expr:
(sum (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op", outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0)
/ sum (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Meter save time (p95)
panels.description: p95 of filegrid_op_duration_seconds for meter writes. Must stay flat during storms in other categories. MeterIngestLatencyHigh fires above 0.5 s.

panels.title: Storm: does a spike in one category slow the others?
Save time, meter vs outage (95 % within)
panels.description: p95 of filegrid_op_duration_seconds (writes). During an outage storm the outage line may rise; the meter line must stay flat and under 0.5 s (MeterIngestLatencyHigh).

panels.title: Work waiting, per category
panels.description: filegrid_queue_depth: items waiting in each category's queue (bulkhead). Until filegrid-api emits it, 'requests in progress' shows all requests being worked on across instances (http_server_requests_active_seconds_gcount, minus the scrape itself).

panels.title: Arrivals per second, per category
panels.description: filegrid_ops_total writes per category: the storm shows as one line jumping tenfold while the others stay put.

panels.title: How long saves and downloads take, per category and storage
Every category on every storage: speed and failures (last 5 min)
panels.description: One row per category × storage × op: p50/p95/p99 from filegrid_op_duration_seconds, throughput and error rate from filegrid_ops_total.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_op_duration_seconds_bucket{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_op_duration_seconds_bucket{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_op_duration_seconds_bucket{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[5m])))
sum by (category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[5m]))

(sum by (category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op", outcome="error"}[5m])) or sum by (category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[5m])) * 0)
/ sum by (category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[5m]))

panels.title: Typical time (half are faster, p50)
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.5) of filegrid_op_duration_seconds per category × storage × op.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_op_duration_seconds_bucket{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Slow end (95 % are faster, p95)
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95) of filegrid_op_duration_seconds per category × storage × op.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_op_duration_seconds_bucket{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Slowest 1 % (p99)
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.99) of filegrid_op_duration_seconds per category × storage × op.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_op_duration_seconds_bucket{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: How much work, and how much of it fails
Operations per second, per category and storage
panels.description: filegrid_ops_total, rate.

targets.expr: sum by (category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failing operations, per category and storage
panels.description: filegrid_ops_total: outcome=error / all operations, per category × storage × op.

targets.expr:
(sum by (category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op", outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0)
/ sum by (category, storage, op) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Saved to the fallback storage instead
panels.description: filegrid_ops_total outcome=fallback: the primary storage refused and the policy's fallback took the write.

targets.expr: sum by (category, storage) (rate(filegrid_ops_total{category=~"$category", storage=~"$storage", op=~"$op", outcome="fallback"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Work per FileGrid instance (scale-out)
panels.description: filegrid_ops_total by scrape instance: with `make scale N=3` the load spreads evenly over the replicas (NFR scalability: scale by adding instances).

panels.title: Smart meters: every reading stored exactly once
Meter readings per second: sent, confirmed, stored, duplicates
panels.description: Exactly-once proof. 'sent' counts unique readings only (retries excluded). 'accepted (FileGrid)' must track 'sent'; retries show up as 'duplicate (FileGrid)', never as extra accepted.

panels.title: Meters sending (readings/s)
panels.description: meter_sim_rate: readings per second after the profile multiplier (peak = 10x). Changes within one scrape.

panels.title: Readings waiting for confirmation
panels.description: meter_sim_sent_total − meter_sim_acked_total since the simulator started: in flight or waiting for retry. A growing number means readings are at risk (MeterReadingLossRisk).

panels.title: Readings sent
panels.description: meter_sim_sent_total: unique readings generated in the selected time range.

panels.title: Readings stored
panels.description: filegrid_meter_readings_total{result=accepted}. Must equal 'Readings sent' once the pipeline drains: never lost, never duplicated.

panels.title: Duplicates refused
panels.description: filegrid_meter_readings_total{result=duplicate}: retries that FileGrid recognised by Idempotency-Key and did not store again.

panels.title: Resends (same key)
panels.description: meter_sim_retries_total: resends by the simulator, always with the same Idempotency-Key and body.

panels.title: Readings per region
panels.description: meter_sim_sent_total by region (Muntenia, Banat, Dobrogea).

panels.title: Confirmations: new vs duplicate
panels.description: meter_sim_acked_total by result: accepted (201) vs duplicate (200).

panels.title: Storages: which are reachable, and what waits for them
Storage reachable
panels.description: filegrid_storage_up: last health probe of each storage by filegrid-api.

panels.title: Storage cut off (circuit breaker)
panels.description: filegrid_circuit_open: OPEN means filegrid-api stopped calling this storage and routes to the fallback.

panels.title: Files waiting for their storage (spool)
panels.description: filegrid_spool_pending: items parked in the fallback spool, waiting for their storage to return.

panels.title: Load tests: synthetic users through the gateway (k6)
Synthetic requests per second
panels.description: k6_http_reqs_total per scenario. Pick a run with the testid variable (e.g. storm-outage-143005).

panels.title: Upload time seen by users (95 % within)
panels.description: k6_http_req_duration_p95: client-side p95 of uploads as k6 sees them through the gateway (TLS included).

panels.title: Checks passing: stored and byte-identical
panels.description: k6_checks_rate: share of k6 checks passing: upload 201, receipt SHA-256 = local SHA-256, download byte-identical, video resumed and complete.
